thesis: The physical house is already the world, inventory topology and capability graph. HOMEBASE is a compact spatial dock inside that world: locus -> prepare -> set out -> return with evidence -> service.

owners.fixtures: HOUSE spatial model anchors and source evidence
owners.loadout: BODY / FIT kits, fittings, route-friction, active session and RETURN/PATINA
owners.runtime: Home Assistant / HOUSEBUS private runtime truth and actuation

inventory_law.catalog: known item/capability definitions; source-owned reference data
inventory_law.inventory: exact instances believed/observed to exist with source and last-known address; HOMEBASE never manufactures this truth
inventory_law.fixture: capability whose useful identity is spatially bound unless explicitly moved/released
inventory_law.loadout: temporary references to source-owned instances for one purpose; BODY / FIT owns the kit/session
inventory_law.service: returned discrepancy/residue supported by evidence; silence never implies READY

env0_law: ENV-0 is coupling/harness, not inventory: STASHED OBJECT -> LOADOUT REFERENCE -> BODY/CART/FURNITURE/HARNESS COUPLING -> DEPLOYED -> RETURNED -> SERVICE.

ux.form: spatial-stage dock over the canonical HOUSE projection; not a sibling dashboard and not forced free-roaming 3D
ux.primary_screen: the selected room/locus and its addressed fixtures remain the main screen
glance_questions: WHICH FIXTURES OR STATIONS ARE ACTUALLY ADDRESSED HERE?
WHAT SOURCE-OWNED LOADOUT / RETURN / SERVICE STATE IS RELEVANT?
ux.shortcut_law: diegetic station and direct route remain equivalent access paths; spatial meaning may not force fake traversal
ux.calm_law: absence of a run or service residue renders calm; it never asserts READY, safety, completion or presence

donors.name: Ultima Online housing
donors.transfer: place-local possession/container relations; explicit edit/commit/revert; Moving Crate staging for displaced objects

donors.name: Monster Hunter loadouts
donors.transfer: task-specific item/equipment sets preserve arrangement and fast preparation without replacing permanent storage

donors.name: Warframe Orbiter
donors.transfer: spatial stations give functions place while direct menu shortcuts preserve low-friction access

donors.name: Death Stranding / Death Stranding 2
donors.transfer: body/load/route are one temporary system; private-room/final-prep loops couple load, route, recovery and return

donors.name: Metal Gear Solid V sortie prep
donors.transfer: mission conditions select among a few explicit loadouts; preparation affects capability without becoming mission truth

donors.name: Animal Crossing home designer
donors.transfer: explicit spatial edit mode allows direct manipulation and returns removed objects to storage instead of silently deleting them

laws: THE SPACE IS THE PRIMARY SCREEN; HOMEBASE IS A DOCK INSIDE IT
LOADOUT = PATCH OVER SOURCE-OWNED STATE, NOT REPLACEMENT OR TELEPORTATION
RETURNED RESIDUE MAY REQUEST SERVICE; UNKNOWN REMAINS UNKNOWN
NO SCORE / QUEST QUEUE / STREAK / COMPLETION PERCENTAGE
NO NEW HOUSE ROUTE OR HOMEBASE PERSISTENCE STORE
proof_gate: The canonical /house/ stage keeps one selected spatial locus visible while HOMEBASE exposes addressed fixtures plus at most PREP / SET OUT / SERVICE, reusing BODY/FIT and Dayline state without copying inventory/loadout truth.
stop: Do not add a general inventory manager, chore board or free-roaming house game. Extend only for a real source-owned object/service/loadout seam that this projection cannot express.
